english: I disagree that coffee cups are characteristic of that which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor a quality of working things, but which is still either a quality of coffee cups or a quality of coffee tables. Suppose you do disagree. In that case, let's consider coffee cups. They are so characteristic of that which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor a quality of working things, but which is still either a quality of coffee cups or a quality of coffee tables; Because (1) they are something which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor a quality of working things, but which is still either a quality of coffee cups or a quality of coffee tables; (2) they are related to something which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor a quality of working things, but which is still either a quality of coffee cups or a quality of coffee tables, in such a way that to be them is to be it; and (3) there are many examples of things which are not coffee cups, but which are still something which is neither a quality of unchanging things nor a quality of working things, but which is still either a quality of coffee cups or a quality of coffee tables.
